2609.31247.title: Geometric Inconsistency Localization in Multi-View Image Sets
2609.31247.paper_summary: Novel view synthesis (NVS) models can produce realistic new views of the same scene from different viewpoints. However, these generated views are not always geometrically consistent with one another. Multi-view (MV) consistency has shown promise as a tool for evaluating these NVS models. Its potential for multimedia forensics, however, remains largely unexplored, particularly for localizing geometric inconsistencies across wide-baseline image pairs. To enable research in this direction, we introduce DeformView, a wide-baseline MV dataset with pixel-level annotations of geometric inconsistencies. Using DeformView, we evaluate state-of-the-art MV consistency-scoring methods and show that approaches developed for NVS evaluation transfer poorly to the forensic task of geometric inconsistency localization. To address this limitation, we propose DEFECt3R, a lightweight learning-based classifier that uses cross-view feature relationships to localize geometric inconsistencies at the pixel level. By learning from explicit supervision, including hard negatives from geometrically consistent yet deformed views, DEFECt3R improves localization performance and substantially reduces false positives compared to existing consistency-scoring methods. Ablation experiments further show that both feature representations and correspondence quality contribute to localization performance. Overall, our findings demonstrate that MV geometric consistency is a promising yet underexplored signal for multimedia forensics and establish a benchmark and baseline for geometric inconsistency localization in wide-baseline MV image pairs. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/IDLabMedia/DeformView-DEFECt3R
2609.31247.paper_summary_zh: 新視角合成（NVS）模型可以從不同的視點生成同一場景的逼真新視圖。<lb/>然而，這些生成的視圖並不總是彼此在幾何上保持一致。<lb/>多視角（MV）一致性已顯示出作為評估這些 NVS 模型的工具的潛力。<lb/>然而，它在多媒體取證中的潛力仍然大部分未被探索，特別是在定位廣基線影像對中的幾何不一致性方面。<lb/>為了促進這方面的研究，我們介紹了 DeformView，一個具有幾何不一致性像素級標註的廣基線 MV 數據集。<lb/>使用 DeformView，我們評估了最先進的 MV 一致性評分方法，並顯示出為 NVS 評估開發的方法在幾何不一致性定位的取證任務中轉移效果不佳。<lb/>為了解決這一限制，我們提出了 DEFECt3R，一種輕量級的基於學習的分類器，利用跨視圖特徵關係在像素級別定位幾何不一致性。<lb/>通過從明確的監督中學習，包括來自幾何一致但變形視圖的困難負樣本，DEFECt3R 改善了定位性能，並顯著減少了與現有一致性評分方法相比的假陽性。<lb/>消融實驗進一步顯示，特徵表示和對應質量都對定位性能有貢獻。<lb/>總體而言，我們的研究結果表明，MV 幾何一致性是一個有前景但尚未充分探索的多媒體取證信號，並為廣基線 MV 影像對中的幾何不一致性定位建立了基準和基線。<lb/>代碼和數據集可在 https://github.com/IDLabMedia/DeformView-DEFECt3R 獲得。
